description: ICMR STW Phase 4 retrieval evaluation dataset. 30 queries covering all entity types, retrieval modes, and abstention cases. Ground truth is based on the actual ICMR cardiology corpus (ICMR-CARD-001 through ICMR-CARD-007). No medical information is invented.

queries.query: STEMI aspirin loading dose
queries.notes: STEMI STW explicitly lists aspirin 325mg loading dose

queries.query: thrombolysis absolute contraindications
queries.notes: STEMI STW lists absolute contraindications to thrombolysis

queries.query: 12 lead ECG ST elevation diagnosis
queries.notes: ECG with ST elevation is the primary diagnostic tool for STEMI

queries.query: atrial fibrillation anticoagulation warfarin
queries.notes: AF STW covers oral anticoagulation including warfarin

queries.query: when to transfer STEMI patient to PCI centre
queries.notes: STEMI STW specifies transfer within 120 minutes to PCI centre

queries.notes: NSTEMI STW specifies anticoagulation with heparin
